content: FastAPI Clean Architecture: domain (entities, repository interfaces, zero framework deps), application/use-case layer (orchestrates domain+infra, no business rules), infrastructure layer (SQLAlchemy/SQLite/API clients implementing the interfaces), API/router layer (FastAPI routes, request/response DTOs). Abstractions live in domain/application; implementations live in infrastructure; dependency inversion via ABCs. Many real-world FastAPI apps organize by feature rather than strict layer folders, but abstraction-in-core / implementation-on-periphery is the consistent rule.
